description.en: Google Antigravity provider. The gateway folds every client text dialect onto the gemini arm; the plugin keeps only the Code Assist v1internal envelope and the OpenAI Images routes (generations and edits).
description.zh: Google Antigravity Provider。文本方言由网关 fold 到 gemini 臂,插件只保留 Code Assist v1internal 包装与 OpenAI 图像路由(生成、编辑)。
